svg.title: Actual practice time vs. the Afuera time
svg.desc: For each practice that reached High or Extreme heat: the day's heat level by hour, the actual practice, and the lower-risk time Afuera would have suggested.
svg.text: Actual practice time vs. the Afuera time
Each row is one practice that reached High or Extreme heat. Cells are that day's heat level, hour by hour.
